summary.text: Jordan Henderson is the Republican candidate for the Tennessee House of Representatives, District 8, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A teacher and U.S. Air National Guard veteran, he is also a former police officer.

paragraphs.text: Jordan Henderson was born in Maryville, Tennessee, and graduated from William Blount High School; he earned a bachelor's degree from Bethel University in 2013 and another from King University in 2021.
He served in the U.S. Air National Guard from 2008 to 2018, and his listed career experience includes teaching and work as a police officer.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Henderson described himself as a Blount County native, a veteran of Operation Iraqi Freedom, a medically retired Knoxville police officer and a high school criminal justice teacher.
He said he is running to ensure that freedom and families thrive in Blount County, and named public safety, education, infrastructure, growth and transparency as his policy interests.
He advanced from the Republican primary for District 8 on August 6, 2026.
